answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus exclusively on voice understanding tasks with text outputs as one first step to examine voice intelligence or its potential voice world model via LLM backbone, which we denote as LLM Voice.

answer_2.quote: We propose a hierarchical IQ test for LLM Voice that evaluates intelligence across three fundamental levels... (1) Remember in verbatim: Lexical accuracy is quantified using WER; (2) Understand: Semantic consistency is assessed... by measuring hidden states similarity... (3) Apply: Task-solving capability is tested via multi-choice question-answering (QA) pairs... QA accuracy is then measured via an exact match...
automatic_metrics: cosine similarity of LLM hidden states

answer_3.quote: We leverage GPT-4o and prompt it to focus on either the core concept or information details in the transcription... we also employ GPT-4o itself and Gemini-1.5-flash to answer these questions using the ground-truth transcription. Questions, where GPT-4o or Gemini-1.5-flash fails to produce correct answers, are discarded and regenerated.

answer_4.quote: we manually check the corresponding speech and annotations... we manually check the outputs of Desta2 and LLama3-8B-Instruct... we invite 10 human individuals to report the average scores as in Table.
answer_4.guideline: human individuals report average scores on hard examples; manual checking of outputs and annotations for hallucinations and unanswerable questions.
